prompts.environments: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background atlas for an original side-scrolling run-and-gun browser game, inspired by late 1980s console arcade pacing. Create ONE wide rectangular image divided into a precise 2-column by 4-row uniform grid, eight equal environment panels with no margins or text. Row 1: left luminous alien jungle with waterfalls and ancient stone bridge; right interior futuristic fortress corridor with glowing reactor. Row 2: left vertical waterfall cliff and rocky forest ledges; right high-tech fortified laboratory corridor. Row 3: left snowy mountain outpost under blue aurora; right orange industrial energy complex. Row 4: left dark alien biological hangar with luminous violet pods; right alien core chamber with turquoise energy heart. Each panel a side-on platform game landscape with open horizontal gameplay space, no heroes, no enemies, no foreground UI. Cohesive beautifully detailed hand-painted 2D game art, modern atmospheric lighting, readable silhouettes, cinematic layered depth, emerald/teal jungle, cool blue snowy scene, orange industry, violet alien interior. Landscape atlas aspect 3:2. Entire image fully filled edge to edge. Original environmental designs, no logos, no characters, no written words.
prompts.characters: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent character sprite atlas for an original modern 2D run-and-gun game. Create 12 isolated sprites in exactly 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, a landscape image aspect 3:2, transparent background. All sprites precisely centered within their own grid cells, plenty of transparent margin, uniform scale, no contact between cells, no dividers, no captions. Row 1: same original muscular BLUE armored futuristic ranger in four poses, column 1 standing aiming compact rifle horizontally RIGHT, column 2 running RIGHT rifle forwards, column 3 curled somersault airborne holding rifle, column 4 prone lying facing RIGHT rifle forwards. Row 2: same four poses for a different RED armored female futuristic ranger with cropped auburn hair, also facing RIGHT. Both wear rugged sci-fi protective armor and boots, full bodies, attractive hand-painted game illustrations, clearly recognizable silhouettes. Row 3: column 1 enemy masked green armored trooper with rifle facing LEFT; column 2 compact orange robotic sentry turret with single gun facing LEFT; column 3 dark green small sci-fi armored tank in side view facing LEFT; column 4 violet alien insect creature in side view facing LEFT. Cohesive professional hand-painted 2D game assets with crisp outlines, highlights, teal/orange accents and tactile materials. New original characters and designs, no replicas of existing game sprites, no logos, no text, no shadows outside silhouette. True transparent background.
prompts.bosses: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: eight original boss sprites for a modern 2D side-scrolling sci-fi run-and-gun game. Exactly 4 equal columns and 2 equal rows on a landscape 3:2 atlas, transparent background, one isolated full boss centered per cell with generous transparent margins. Row 1 left to right: a large jungle fortress gate with two gun turrets and one exposed glowing red circular core; a tall industrial reactor panel with three circular glowing weak points; a hovering blue alien saucer with three orange exposed energy cores along its underside; a giant mechanical security face with two blue glowing eyes and a red central weak point. Row 2: a heavily armored futuristic snow hovercraft side view facing left with bright orange cannon; a bulky orange armored mechanical giant full body standing side view facing left; a towering dark industrial crushing machine with red hydraulic claws, frontal view; a large luminous violet and crimson alien heart held in an organic rib-like structure with four tendrils. Beautiful cohesive hand-painted 2D game illustration, crisp silhouettes, readable exposed energy cores, textured metal and organic detail, original designs rather than recreations of copyrighted character visuals. No heroes, no text, no labels, no border, no scenery. Actual transparent background.
